[SWS_DM_00948] Occurrence Counter upper limit
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04125
⌈
If an occurrence counter has reached its maximum value of 255 and the conditions to
increment this occurrence counter are met, the DM module shall latch this occurrence
counter at its maximum value.
⌋
A rollover of the occurrence counter byte from 255 to 0 must be avoided.
